results.name: Dumbbell Lying Supine Curl
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms fully extended towards the floor by your sides, and palms facing your thighs.
Curl the dumbbells by bending your elbows until your forearms are parallel to the floor while rotating the dumbbells to face backward.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary and only move your forearms to ensure maximum bicep engagement.
Avoid using momentum; focus on a slow and controlled motion throughout the exercise.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Lying Supine Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell One Arm Hammer Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench and place your right elbow on the arm pad, holding a dumbbell in a neutral grip (palm facing inward).
Keeping your elbow pressed against the pad, curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by bending your elbow.
Squeeze your bicep at the top of the movement, ensuring the dumbbell reaches shoulder height.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arm. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
tips: Keep your upper arm pressed firmly against the preacher pad to isolate the biceps.
Perform the movement in a slow and controlled manner to maximize muscle engagement.
Avoid swinging the dumbbell or using momentum to lift the weight.
results.description: Dumbbell One Arm Hammer Preacher Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your right arm extended over the pad, holding a dumbbell in your right hand using an overhand grip (palm facing down). Keep your right upper arm pressed against the pad.
Curl the dumbbell upward towards your shoulder by bending your elbow, focusing on engaging your biceps and forearm muscles.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the dumbbell reaches shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arm. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
tips: Keep your upper arm pressed firmly against the pad to isolate your biceps.
Avoid using your back or shoulder to lift the weight.
Perform the movement slowly and with control and avoid using momentum.
results.description: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Preacher Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell One Arm Zottman Preacher Curl
instructions: Stand behind an incline bench and lean your right arm on the bench's headrest, holding a dumbbell in your hand with an underhand grip (palm facing up).
Curl the dumbbell upward towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary and focusing on engaging your biceps.
At the top of the curl, rotate your wrist to turn your palm downward, transitioning to an overhand grip.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with the overhand grip. Rotate your wrist back to the underhand grip for the next repetition. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arm pressed against the bench's headrest throughout the exercise.
Focus on a slow and controlled wrist rotation at the top of the curl.
Use a lighter weight to master the wrist rotation and prevent strain.
results.description: Dumbbell One Arm Zottman Preacher Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl (Turned Torso)
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench and place your left arm on the padding, twisting your torso slightly to the right. Hold a dumbbell in your left hand with an underhand grip (palm facing up), allowing your arm to hang straight down.
Engage your biceps and curl the dumbbell upward towards your shoulder by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary against the bench.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the dumbbell reaches shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arm. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arm pressed firmly against the preacher bench to isolate the biceps.
Avoid using momentum; focus on a slow and controlled movement.
Use a full range of motion for maximum muscle engagement.
results.description: Dumbbell Preacher Curl (Turned Torso) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl Over Exercise Ball
instructions: Kneel on the floor in front of an exercise ball. Lean forward to position your chest against the ball, and rest your upper arms on the ball. Hold a dumbbell with both hands with an underhand grip (palm facing up).
Engage your biceps and curl the dumbbells upward towards your shoulders by bending your elbows, ensuring your upper arms remain stationary against the ball.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the dumbbells reaches shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arm. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms pressed firmly against the exercise ball to isolate the biceps.
Avoid using momentum; focus on a slow and controlled movement.
Exhale as you curl the dumbbells upward and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Dumbbell Preacher Curl Over Exercise Ball is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and lie chest first on the bench. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended down and palms facing forward.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the dumbbells reach shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on a slow and controlled motion to maximize bicep engagement.
Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
Avoid swinging the weights to isolate the biceps during the curl.
results.description: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing down). Let the dumbbells hang by your sides.
Keep your upper arms close to your body. Curl the dumbbells upward towards your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the dumbbells reach shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and avoid bending them throughout the movement.
Keep your elbows close to your sides to ensure proper form.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
